{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df['revenue'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and remove QA rows (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue'] == 999999.99

df_clean = df[~qa_mask].copy()

# Now filter for NEW customers reached by PAID SEARCH
target_mask = (df_clean['customer_segment'] == 'new') & (df_clean['channel'] == 'paid_search')

target_df = df_clean[target_mask]

# Check for refunded orders in the target population
refunded_mask = target_df['status'] == 'refunded'
print(f"Number of refunded orders in target population: {refunded_mask.sum()}")
print(f"Total target population size: {len(target_df)}")
print(f"Number of converted orders: {target_df['converted'].sum()}")

# Compute conversion rate
conversion_rate = target_df['converted'].mean()
conversion_rate"}
